entities.summary: Aleksandrs Čaks [ɑ.lɛk.sɑndrs ˈklɑu̯ns tʃɑks], was a Latvian poet and writer. Čaks is arguably the first Latvian writer whose works are distinctly urban, compared to the usual depictions of country life or small villages in earlier Latvian literature.
